suggestion: Land CL55; then a part whose step is Done saves to wip/<branch>, never its step branch, so a checkpoint never blocks kit.py land.
text:
**continue** · Land CL55. Next: once a step's post records its Done (`proof`), its part's save goes to wip/<branch>, never to the step branch, so an automatic checkpoint can no longer block `kit.py land`. Today `land` refuses any commit made after the review, and CL55 adds one every five minutes whenever the tree is dirty.

## Holds
- Check rerun: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_cl55_wip_public tests.test_landing` passes on cl55 at d7c0c22.
- Break rerun: its sed in a scratch worktree (it hits 2 lines of kit/landing.py): 3 failures, 1 error. Undone.
- Recheck sample, "1 of 1 live save reached GitHub": checkpoint 3fd3cb2 ("saved by the save hook", 23:42:04Z) is on origin/cl55. Git does not record when it was pushed, so I can't confirm "seconds after"; that it is there, unprompted, is what counts.
- Real project (orchestrator, Harmonize scratch copy, push to a local bare repo): the save was pushed to wip/main-…; a planted `ghp_` token was REFUSED with file:line and the bare repo stayed unchanged; a part branch's save was pushed to its branch. Not run on real data: a takeover from the newest save (the test covers it).
- **Together with CL45 (joint fix, which carries CL51) and CL53:** cl45 + cl53 + cl55 merge with one conflict only, in the generated `.kit/artifact-files/files-board.json` files map. With it resolved, `run_all_tests.py --all` gives **75 passed, 0 failed** (e561bb1). The handoff is right: CL55 changes web_takeover's continuation text only, not the reconcile path, and nothing in CL45, CL51 or CL53 contradicts it. CL53b moves only the trunk, so a part branch full of checkpoints is never switched.
- **Not CL55's, found while running it:** CL48's `test_the_default_board_url_is_refused_in_a_test_run` (on origin/main 320c31f too) fails when no board server listens on 127.0.0.1:8765. board_cli says "cannot reach" before the guard's REFUSED. It passed once this container's board was up. A suite that depends on the machine's live board is CL48's to fix.

## Goal
The takeover train: a session lost anywhere is continued from where it was. CL55 closes the biggest hole: on this public repo, nothing unfinished used to leave the container (GitHub had no wip branch on 26 November).

The posts together show a cost the step does not name. Two of the three landings in this group were refused today for commits made after the review: cl53 (a58968f "checkpoint(cl53): save progress" plus the fix) and cl45 (c4ad7d3 "checkpoint(cl45): save progress", then a files-map commit). Each needs `done` and `review --force` again. CL55 makes those checkpoints automatic, every 5 minutes, pushed to the step branch. Artifact pushes rewrite `.kit/artifact-files/*` after a Done, so a finished part's tree is often dirty. Without the change suggested above, refused landings will become routine.

## Verdict
**continue.** Land CL55. Then one small follow-up, ready for a prompt: "A part whose post has its proof (Done) saves to wip/<branch>, not to its step branch; `land` keeps refusing real commits after the review."
